fusions.name: Aim From Cover
fusions.desc: Settles in behind your shell for 2 seconds, then fires a shot that deals 38 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Point-Blank Recoil
fusions.desc: A blast into the cone ahead of you that deals 11 damage to everything in it and knocks it back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 7% for every 10% of your health already gone (max +35%).

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Hunker still for 1.5 seconds, then your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Powder Kept Dry
fusions.desc: When a long run of your hits fails to crit, your next ability deals 40% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
